stories.headline: Mahomes Saddles Back Up for a Broncos Showdown
stories.read: Well pardner, the King of the Chiefs is back in the saddle after that nasty knee bust-up back in December, and Andy Reid says there's a mighty good chance he rides out Monday night against Denver. That Broncos outfit held quarterbacks to the stingiest yardage in the territory last year, so don't go expecting fireworks right outta the gate. Still, a healthy Mahomes under center turns every Chiefs pass-catcher back into paydirt. Ride him with confidence, just keep the ceiling on a short leash till he shakes off the rust.

stories.headline: A.J. Brown Laid Up With a Busted Wing in New England
stories.read: Brown rode east to the Patriots this summer and lasted about a quarter and a half before a high-ankle sprain sent him to the sidelines in the opener against Seattle. The wire says he's ruled out, and a sprain like that usually means a week or two nursing that wing before he's back to full speed. Bad news for Brown's owners, but every other Patriots pass-catcher just got a fatter cut of the throws. Go stake your claim on whoever steps into that gap before the rest of the saloon catches wise.

stories.headline: Season Kicks Off Down Under, Rams Ride Without Donald
stories.read: The great land grab is officially underway, pardner. Rams and Niners kick off the whole season clear out in Melbourne, and Sean McVay's leaving legend Aaron Donald home to ease back into the game after two years off the trail. Don't fret the Rams pass rush none, Myles Garrett's fit and ready to ride. Over on the Niners side, George Kittle and Nick Bosa both cleared with no injury designation, so Kittle's locked in as a TE1 right out of the gate.
